description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling progress-related API endpoints in a Scrum or Agile project management context. It includes a GET endpoint '/summary' that provides an aggregate overview of task statuses, counts, and velocity, with optional filtering by board or sprint.

classes.name: ProgressSummary
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the summary of progress, including total task count, counts by status, and velocity.

methods.name: progress_summary( board_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter tasks by board"), sprint_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter tasks by sprint"), session: Session = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint handler that queries tasks, computes counts and velocity based on task status and optional filters, and returns a ProgressSummary.

ctags.name: progress_summary
ctags.signature: ( board_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter tasks by board"), sprint_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter tasks by sprint"), session: Session = Depends(get_session), )
